weekly_outcome: Introduce Yourself: Give a simple 30–60 second introduction.
speaking_mission: Give a 60-second self-introduction
primary_language_support: name, country/city, work/study, interests, basic be

weekly_outcome: Talk About Where You Live: Describe where you live and what it is like.
speaking_mission: Describe where you live for 60–90 seconds
primary_language_support: there is/are, place vocabulary, basic adjectives, prepositions

weekly_outcome: Talk About Likes & Dislikes: Express preferences and ask others about theirs.
speaking_mission: Talk about five likes and dislikes naturally
primary_language_support: like/love/hate, do/don't, hobbies, preference questions

weekly_outcome: Describe Your Daily Routine: Describe a typical day in simple connected sentences.
speaking_mission: Describe a typical day for 60–90 seconds
primary_language_support: present simple, time, usually/sometimes/never, routine verbs

weekly_outcome: Talk About Your Family: Describe family members and relationships.
speaking_mission: Describe your family for 1–2 minutes
primary_language_support: have/has, possessives, family vocabulary, describing people

weekly_outcome: Talk About Your Home: Describe your home and where things are.
speaking_mission: Describe your home for 1–2 minutes
primary_language_support: there is/are, in/on/under/next to, rooms, objects

weekly_outcome: Talk About Friends: Talk about friends and what you do together.
speaking_mission: Talk about a friend for 1–2 minutes
primary_language_support: present simple, and/but, friendship vocabulary, activities

weekly_outcome: Talk About Feelings: Say how you feel and give a simple reason.
speaking_mission: Describe how you feel and why
primary_language_support: feel/am, because, emotion vocabulary, basic reasons

weekly_outcome: Express Wants & Needs: Say what you want or need in everyday situations.
speaking_mission: Explain what you need in three everyday situations
primary_language_support: want/need, would like, things/places, polite language

weekly_outcome: Ask for Help: Ask for help clearly and politely.
speaking_mission: Ask for help naturally in an unfamiliar situation
primary_language_support: can/could, please, help vocabulary, requests

weekly_outcome: Offer Help: Offer help and respond naturally.
speaking_mission: Offer, accept or decline help naturally
primary_language_support: can I, would you like, accept/decline, service expressions

weekly_outcome: Agree & Disagree: Show simple agreement or disagreement respectfully.
speaking_mission: Express and explain one agreement and one disagreement
primary_language_support: I agree, I don't think so, because, opinion words

weekly_outcome: Ask for Clarification: Ask someone to repeat or explain something.
speaking_mission: Handle a short conversation when you do not understand
primary_language_support: sorry?, could you repeat, what do you mean, clarification

weekly_outcome: Thank & Apologize: Thank people and apologize appropriately.
speaking_mission: Handle a thank-you and apology conversation naturally
primary_language_support: thank you, sorry, excuse me, responses

weekly_outcome: Invite & Respond: Invite someone and accept or decline an invitation.
speaking_mission: Invite someone and handle their response
primary_language_support: would you like, let's, accept/decline, social plans

weekly_outcome: Make Simple Plans: Talk about plans for the near future.
speaking_mission: Describe your plans for the next week
primary_language_support: going to, will, tomorrow/this weekend, plan verbs

weekly_outcome: Talk About Time: Talk about schedules, times and simple appointments.
speaking_mission: Arrange a simple appointment
primary_language_support: at/on/in, days/dates, before/after, time expressions

weekly_outcome: Talk About Food: Order food and talk about food preferences.
speaking_mission: Talk about food and order a simple meal
primary_language_support: I'd like, some/any, menu vocabulary, preferences

weekly_outcome: At a Café: Handle a simple café interaction.
speaking_mission: Complete a café interaction from start to finish
primary_language_support: ordering, prices, quantities, polite requests

weekly_outcome: Shopping: Ask about products, prices and choices.
speaking_mission: Buy an item and handle a follow-up question
primary_language_support: How much, this/that, sizes/colors, buying language

weekly_outcome: Ask for Directions: Ask for and understand simple directions.
speaking_mission: Ask for and give directions naturally
primary_language_support: where is, turn/go, left/right, landmarks

weekly_outcome: Talk About Transportation: Discuss how you travel and basic transport problems.
speaking_mission: Explain your route and solve a small transport problem
primary_language_support: take/go by, can/can't, transport vocabulary, time

weekly_outcome: At a Hotel: Handle basic hotel interactions.
speaking_mission: Check in and solve a simple hotel problem
primary_language_support: check in, need/want, room vocabulary, requests

weekly_outcome: Everyday Problems: Explain a simple problem and ask what to do.
speaking_mission: Explain a real or imagined everyday problem
primary_language_support: there is a problem, because, can't, solutions

weekly_outcome: Describe Past Events: Talk about something that happened recently.
speaking_mission: Describe something that happened recently
primary_language_support: past simple, yesterday/last, regular past verbs, sequence

weekly_outcome: Talk About Experiences: Talk about things you have done in simple terms.
speaking_mission: Talk about three experiences naturally
primary_language_support: ever/never, have + past participle, experience vocabulary

weekly_outcome: Tell a Short Story: Tell a short story with a clear sequence.
speaking_mission: Tell a 90-second story with a clear sequence
primary_language_support: first/then/after that/finally, past verbs, story verbs

weekly_outcome: Talk About Yesterday: Describe yesterday in connected speech.
speaking_mission: Describe yesterday in 1–2 minutes
primary_language_support: past simple, time sequence, routine vs past

weekly_outcome: Talk About Future Plans: Describe upcoming plans and intentions.
speaking_mission: Describe your plans for the next month
primary_language_support: going to/will, future time, plan verbs

weekly_outcome: Make Decisions: State a simple choice and explain why.
speaking_mission: Make and explain a simple decision
primary_language_support: I think, because, or, comparatives

weekly_outcome: Give Simple Opinions: Give an opinion and one or two reasons.
speaking_mission: Give your opinion with two reasons
primary_language_support: I think, I prefer, because, opinion vocabulary

weekly_outcome: Compare Things: Compare familiar people, places and things.
speaking_mission: Compare two places, products or activities
primary_language_support: bigger/more, than, both/but, comparison language

weekly_outcome: Give Simple Advice: Give and respond to everyday advice.
speaking_mission: Give three pieces of useful everyday advice
primary_language_support: should, shouldn't, maybe, advice situations

weekly_outcome: Talk About Health: Describe simple symptoms and ask for help.
speaking_mission: Explain a simple health problem and ask for help
primary_language_support: have/feel, body/health words, should, questions

weekly_outcome: Talk About Weather: Describe weather and make simple plans around it.
speaking_mission: Talk about weather and your plans
primary_language_support: it's, present/future, weather vocabulary, because/so

weekly_outcome: Talk About Hobbies: Talk about hobbies and ask follow-up questions.
speaking_mission: Talk about a hobby for 2 minutes
primary_language_support: like + -ing, how often, why, activity vocabulary

weekly_outcome: Keep a Conversation Going: Use follow-up questions and short reactions.
speaking_mission: Keep a conversation going for 5 minutes
primary_language_support: really?, what about you?, why/how, conversation fillers

weekly_outcome: Describe People: Describe someone's appearance and personality.
speaking_mission: Describe a person for 1–2 minutes
primary_language_support: be/have, adjectives, looks/personality, and/but

weekly_outcome: Describe Places: Describe a familiar place and what you can do there.
speaking_mission: Give a 2-minute description of a familiar place
primary_language_support: there is/are, can, place adjectives, prepositions

weekly_outcome: Talk About Memories: Share a simple memory and respond to someone else's.
speaking_mission: Tell a 2-minute personal memory
primary_language_support: past simple, when, because, memory vocabulary

weekly_outcome: Handle Small Talk: Start and maintain a short casual conversation.
speaking_mission: Have a 5-minute small-talk conversation
primary_language_support: greetings, small talk questions, responses, topic shifts

weekly_outcome: Handle Everyday Phone/Chat English: Communicate simple information by phone or chat.
speaking_mission: Complete a realistic phone or chat interaction
primary_language_support: can/could, short messages, confirming, asking questions

weekly_outcome: Solve a Small Problem: Explain a problem, ask for help and respond to a solution.
speaking_mission: Explain and resolve a small everyday problem
primary_language_support: problem/solution, because/so, could, follow-ups

weekly_outcome: Talk About Goals & Dreams: Talk about personal goals and simple reasons.
speaking_mission: Talk about your goals for 2 minutes
primary_language_support: want to, hope to, would like to, future vocabulary

weekly_outcome: Talk About Change: Describe how something is different now.
speaking_mission: Describe a meaningful change in your life
primary_language_support: used to/basic contrast, now/before, comparatives, change vocabulary

weekly_outcome: Express Preferences in Conversation: Discuss choices and respond to different preferences.
speaking_mission: Discuss a preference and reach a shared choice
primary_language_support: prefer, rather, because, agreement/disagreement

weekly_outcome: Have a 5-Minute Everyday Conversation: Sustain a conversation across several familiar topics.
speaking_mission: Hold a 5-minute everyday conversation
primary_language_support: follow-ups, topic changes, reactions, repair strategies

weekly_outcome: Handle an Unexpected Question: Respond to simple questions without a script.
speaking_mission: Respond to five spontaneous everyday questions
primary_language_support: thinking time, clarification, because, spontaneous speaking

weekly_outcome: Tell a Personal Story: Tell a 2–3 minute personal story with a clear beginning, middle and end.
speaking_mission: Tell a 2–3 minute personal story
primary_language_support: story sequencing, past verbs, feelings, details

weekly_outcome: Everyday Confidence Mission: Handle a spontaneous everyday conversation with confidence.
speaking_mission: Final Beginner Mission: handle a spontaneous everyday conversation
primary_language_support: integrated review, fluency, repair, conversation strategies
